summary: Filled atom parts of both zone3_from_bracket and nf_eval_from_enriched_witnesses in KampBypassK1.lean. Proved backward between_tx direction in nf_eval_from_enriched_witnesses using zone3_witnesses hypothesis. Added zone_general_between_tx_orders and pred_transfer_from_1var helper lemmas. Seven sorry stubs remain in quantifier transfer and zone classification areas.

sorry_inventory.assumption: 3-var existential with w < t factors through constant-env 2-var existential at t
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Requires showing below_t 3-var NF [w,x,t] factors into 2-var NF at [w,t] plus fixed x conditions, then depth2_quant_transfer from h_t applies
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Factor below_t 3-var existential into constant-env 2-var existential
Build eq_t zone bridge using constenv_same_depth_nvar + h_x

sorry_inventory.assumption: Given w in M with between_tx evaluation, find w0 in M0
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: zone3_witnesses only provides M0->M direction; forward requires prior_exist_transfer_bidir-style argument
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Implement forward between_tx transfer using zone_compatible_witness
Build eq_x zone bridge analogous to eq_t

sorry_inventory.assumption: 3-var existential with w > x factors through constant-env 2-var at x
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Symmetric to below_t using h_x instead of h_t
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Factor above_x 3-var existential into constant-env 2-var existential

sorry_inventory.assumption: Contradictory order atoms mean no point satisfies chi
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Requires ssn_order_consistent-style reasoning at general depth
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Prove inconsistent zone implies empty existential

sorry_inventory.assumption: depth-(K+1) 3-var NF agreement between M,[w,x,t] and M0,[w0,x0,t0]
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Circular: proving this agreement IS the current theorem. For K=0, depth-0 4-var is purely atomic and could be handled directly. For K>0, need inductive multi-var agreement from 1-var.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: K=0: direct zone analysis on depth-0 4-var. K>0: separate inductive lemma for multi-var agreement from 1-var.

blockers: zone3_from_bracket quantifier part: circular dependency on depth-(K+1) 3-var NF agreement
nf_eval_from_enriched_witnesses non-between zones: require constant-env factoring or zone_compatible_witness infrastructure

proved: zone3_from_bracket: full atom part (predicates + all 6 order cases)
nf_eval_from_enriched_witnesses: full atom part for 2-var env
nf_eval_from_enriched_witnesses: backward between_tx direction via zone3_witnesses
continuation_context.key_insight: The circularity in zone3_from_bracket can be broken for K=0 by direct zone analysis on depth-0 4-var NFs. For K>0, a separate inductive lemma building multi-var NF agreement from 1-var agreements is needed.
